def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):

def components(grid, bg, connect=8):
    """All 4- or 8-connected components of non-background cells as (cells, color) lists."""
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                seen.add((i,j))
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for da in (-1,0,1):
                        for db in (-1,0,1):
                            if connect==4 and da and db: continue
                            na,nb=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and grid[na][nb]!=bg and (na,nb) not in seen:
                                seen.add((na,nb)); stack.append((na,nb))
                comps.append(comp)
    return comps
''')
